resources.string: Everything has a sensible default. Move right to open a row, or start right away.
Every row is done. Change any of them now, or start.
The same pages are in Launcher settings.

TMDB account (Movies, TV Shows, Search and Pick for me), Price lookup and Weather start on; Phone notes and Phone remote start off, since each opens a port for phones. Each has its own row, set up next, with its own On/Off. One not set up when you finish is switched off.
Each one’s On/Off is in its own section of Launcher settings; Features there shows them all.
What does the household pay for?
Titles on these services show as Included in Movies and TV Shows. The ones with an app on this TV were ticked to start with.
→ opens the same pane as Launcher settings › Streaming services.
Where may we show prices from?
Rent and buy prices in kronor come from these stores, the cheapest first.
Rent and buy prices in dollars come from these stores, the cheapest first.
→ opens the same pane as Launcher settings › Stores for rent and buy.
